tasks.title: Qualify Hoon skills, editor tooling and contributor workflow
acceptance: Review and pin upstream skill candidates; no bulk installation or live credentials.
Run frozen compiler/runtime tasks with and without skill assistance; report actual outcomes.

tasks.title: Publish inter-app API, versioned marks and conformance SDK
acceptance: Publish stable developer marks and API with bounded versioned envelopes.
Independent client compiles and passes allow/deny, replay and version-negotiation tests.

tasks.title: Implement private-by-default search, relations, activity and inbox
acceptance: Rebuild search, activity and inbox from accepted records without leaking metadata.
Revocation, stale views, replay and interruption tests pass.

tasks.title: Bound storage, Git/LFS transfers, background jobs and garbage collection
acceptance: Publish measured quotas and bounded import/job/GC behavior.
Test malformed packs, storage exhaustion, interruption and cross-domain storage boundaries.

tasks.title: Maintain native threat model, identity lifecycle and data-custody controls
acceptance: Freeze threat-to-route/test and custody/identity-lifecycle contract.
Owning feature tests verify each applicable threat before release; a design review is not runtime acceptance.

tasks.title: Package reproducible desks and establish safe distribution channels
acceptance: Install self-contained pinned desk and matching frontend from verified artifacts.
Test release provenance, channel promotion, wrong Kelvin/glob and unavailable publisher.

tasks.title: Qualify state migrations, mixed-version operation and recovery
acceptance: Test every supported saved-state migration and client/peer/kernel combination.
Recover interrupted upgrade without duplicate effects or resurrected access.

tasks.title: Implement loss-aware imports and portable migration contracts
acceptance: Import Git/Markdown/Stead JSON with faithful identity and explicit loss reports.
Resume/dry-run/rollback and malformed/ambiguous source cases pass.

tasks.title: Isolate build runners and bind artifact evidence to accepted work
acceptance: Run untrusted builds outside authority host with scoped credentials.
Bind verifiable artifact evidence to exact code, policy and accepted result.

tasks.title: Make onboarding, accessibility and nondeveloper workflows release criteria
acceptance: Independent user completes accessible Work/Docs flow without maintainer assistance.
Test keyboard, Unicode/time-zone, offline/error and privacy-safe support paths.

tasks.title: Establish maintainership, security reporting and public-release governance
acceptance: Verify maintainer backup, private security reporting and release-key recovery.
Human owner explicitly approves visibility/public release after history/license review.

tasks.title: Qualify independent ecosystem beta and stable 1.0 release
acceptance: Two independent teams and a third-party app validate supported release profiles.
No unresolved release-blocking security/data-loss defect; publish support, upgrade and recovery evidence.

milestones.title: M0 - Reproducible native development
milestones.exit: Actual native allow/deny smoke test, pinned inputs and Git reuse decision. Skills qualification follows the first harness; it does not block that first run.

milestones.title: M1 - Authoritative Work and Docs
milestones.exit: Versioned native state, explicit authorization, conflict/idempotency and cold-restart tests. Minimal canonical Git-backed document persistence is required; the full forge arrives later.

milestones.title: M2 - Usable team alpha
milestones.exit: Independent sessions, real multi-user Work/Docs journey, private search/activity, stable API sample and native CI; Work+Docs acceptance precedes Code activation.

milestones.title: M3 - Native software collaboration
milestones.exit: Ordinary Git fidelity, exact-revision reviews, scoped agents and isolated builds under bounded workload.

milestones.title: M4 - Installable and recoverable beta
milestones.exit: Real desk install/upgrade, verified exports/restore, measured canary, private-data controls and loss-aware import.

milestones.title: M5 - Federation and self-dogfooding
milestones.exit: Explicit replicas, fenced home migration and one native source of truth with optional one-way GitHub mirror. Browser-only identity scope is declared accurately.

milestones.title: M6 - Supported ecosystem release
milestones.exit: Independent adopters and app integration, backup maintainer, tested security reporting and documented supported profiles. Dogfooding alone is insufficient.

external_skill_candidates.finding: safe review annotation is not a works annotation; sampled minimal save/load version envelope is inconsistent.
